cross_owner_experiments.chosen_workload: Explicit complete residual-dropout layer forward and paired backward. No implicit CNN/transformer route is claimed.

arms.A: One forward producer for dropout then rounded residual; one backward producer for dValues and raw-word dResidual.
arms.B: Dropout temporary plus separate residual addition; backward dropout kernel plus separate gradient copy. CPU baseline uses separate passes.

Shared pure Mojo FP32 dropout product seam, residual add seam, portable scale. Backward regenerates same mask for identical coordinates.
admission: IDENTICAL only; native float32 C-contiguous equal-shape inputs

Native Float32 p finite in [0,1); scale computed in Mojo as 1/(1-p)
uint64 seed; uint32 stream; nonnegative Int64 offset with admitted offset+n; n fits Int32
Disjoint borrowed outputs and inputs; empty shapes admitted without pointer access
